Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original in-game equipment sprite source sheet, hand-painted fantasy material study, transparent background. The first reference provides the existing RagRPG weapons' elongated SINGLE ROW canvas proportions and rendering style; the second confirms cast painting, texture and palette for gear. Copy the style and arrangement, not the reference items. Produce an ultrawide landscape native PNG around 2172 × 724 or wider, real RGBA with exactly ONE horizontal row of independently isolated objects. One object or intentionally grouped pair per column, each on its own distinct horizontal centre with very wide, completely clean transparent gap around it. All objects upright as gripped, handle to bottom and tip to top where they have a handle. All read well at 80×130 in game: classic fantasy proportions, finely painted organic outline, substantial volume, clearly rendered leather, metal and wood. Painted art, not pixel art. Neutral upper-left highlights, strong clear silhouettes. The whole area behind and between objects must be genuinely clear alpha without haze, glare, scenery or background. No hands, people, captions, letters, imitation text, frame, grid, floor, cast shadow, drop shadow or effects.

This sheet has exactly 7 equally spaced positions on the single horizontal row. From left to right, one per column in exactly this order: (1) a SMALL upright closed prayer book, warm ivory or pale tan leather with a clearly divided two-color round pale gold and plum/black medallion in the center; (2) pale metal halo scepter, slim upright handle pointing down, open circular gold ring on the top; (3) oxidized dark bronze eye reliquary, one single eye inset in an upright caged metal pendant with a short coiled chain above the body, read clearly at thumbnail scale; (4) black leather contract tome with a heat-branded emblem on its closed cover, one short real iron chain wound around the book and a padlock, no actual flame; (5) tall upright bone staff assembled of coarse pale tied bones with one small skull and one ochre mushroom at top, its handle pointing down; (6) tall upright living wooden staff with a few leaves and a single pale flower at the crown, slim gnarled shaft and handle pointing down; (7) a rosary made from individual wooden beads arrayed in one evenly readable open vertical floating ring, a few bead gaps, nothing supporting it, no magic graphics. Tight silhouettes and generous spacing on BOTH sides of each of the seven objects. The books are upright closed front covers at slight three-quarter, not lying flat.
